svg.title: Flash Attention UML — all functions, parameters, return types, and call relationships
svg.desc: Four modules (Helpers, Attention, MultiHead, Driver) shown as UML class boxes with full signatures. Arrows show which functions call which.
svg.text: + rows: int, cols: int, init: float = 0
+ a: const float[], b: const float[]
+ A: const Matrix, B: const Matrix
m : float running max of scores seen so far (−∞ initially)
l : float Σ exp(sⱼ − m) running denominator (0 initially)
acc : float[] Σ exp(sⱼ − m)·Vⱼ running numerator (0 initially)
Rescale rule: corr = exp(m_old − m_new); l *= corr; acc *= corr
Bc: int tile width per head
+ ref: const Matrix, got: const Matrix
8. print table: N, ms, speedup, MB
flash_attention() inner loop — per query row i
